text:
maya: Quick check — onboarding nebula-3b weights are they live at s3://redwood-models/nebula/3b/v1/weights.tar.gz ? I found two manifests in the bucket and want to avoid serving the wrong one. Also noticed tokenizer is sentencepiece (model.spm) and we saw weird splits on emoji+ZWJ in the smoke runs. Need to coordinate config validation + goldset/regression runs (structured tool-calls too). Who can pick this up?

akshay: I pushed a small PR to update the weights path in model-manifests. The correct file is v1/manifest-v1.json. See PR in repo: github.com/redwood/models/PRs/4123. Tokenizer note: nebula uses spm with legacy normalization; set `spm_nlnorm: false` in runtime config to avoid double-normalization.

samir: Confirmed checksums on staging: ran `sha256sum weights.tar.gz` against the v1 bundle — matches recorded sum. I'll add the checksum to manifest-v1.json. Also flagged kv_cache config: set max_seq=4096 and enable kv partitioning for multi-GPU.

eva: For evals I'm assembling the goldset: focused on structured outputs + tool-calling. Plan: 20 tool-call smoke cases (calendar, calc, external-search) and 150 golden prompts including negative/regression cases. I'll drop the goldset at /evals/nebula/struct-tools.json and a README for schema.

maya: Can someone run a quick staging smoke that does a single forward + tool-call with the new manifest? CI lint is blocking merge currently.

ci-bot: build #4892: model-manifest lint — failed — missing checksum in manifest-v1.json. See: https://ci.redwood/4892/logs

akshay: On it, pushed manifest update that includes the checksum + small runtime config tweak. PR #4123 updated.

samir: Tokenizer edge: emoji + zero-width-joiner (ZWJ) sequences like 👩‍🔬 were splitting into multiple tokens in our tokenization pass. Drafting tokenizer adapter PR to rejoin ZWJ sequences before spm encoding. Will add unit tests for sequences: `
```
{"examples": ["👩\u200d🔬", "👨\u200d🚀"]}
```

eva: For the gold outputs, include explicit schema examples and one clear negative test that should fail (to catch regressions). Also we need to validate streaming + function-calling fallback: previously we saw HTTP 200 but truncated tool JSON on streaming cutoffs.

maya: Who can run full goldset on staging once the tokenizer PR and manifest checksum are in? Assign to @samir for checksum + run, @eva for goldset, I'll monitor results and handle rollout decisions.

samir: Starting run now on staging: batch=8, timeout=60m. Will post logs when done.

ci-bot: deploy hook: staging inference pool health OK — 3/3 nodes, avg latency 48ms.

samir: Run finished: tool-call smoke 20/20 passed; golden prompts 48/50 passed. 2 failures are schema mismatches (unexpected extra keys/order) traced to tokenizer splitting earlier. Filing issue #993 with stack and sample diff.

maya: Thanks — created a follow-up ticket in productboard and linked issue #993. Next steps: (1) merge tokenizer adapter PR, (2) update manifest checksum on master, (3) rerun full goldset. Target ETA: end of week. Ping me on slack if CI still blocks. :thumbsup:
